title: The Dizzy Gillespie and Cab Calloway knife incident
summary: Cab thought he saw Dizzy's hand throw a spitball; the quarrel ended with Dizzy scratching Cab's hand and Cab hurting his thigh on a trunk lock, which Down Beat blew up.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong

blocks.x: See, this was done all over the country. This wasn't the first place we started. Cab come out there and seen this stuff all over the floor of the stage and never said a word. It was in Chicago, maybe in Philadelphia, at the Earl. Anyway, just that day, in the theater, he come to the wings, and he swore he saw Dizzy's hand up in the air. He come out there and he's mad. He's cursing. Now the finale's coming on. The girls and boys are dancing, you know. And they're arguing, back and forth, at each. "You little simple so-and-so, why are you throwing that? When you going to grow up?" You know. "You lyin'! It wasn't me! And Cab, you another lie! It was!" Now the curtain goes closed, you know, and Cab starts around the [wagon] after Diz, and Diz jumps down, so we, the brass section, we grabbed Diz, and Chew and them they grabbed Cab, you know. We said, well, we were just kidding, and just say don't do it no more, and we won't do it. So Cab -- they turned Cab loose and he started walking that way to his dressing room. We were supposed to go this way.

We turned Diz loose, and Diz run up behind him and scratched him on the hand. Wasn't nothing bad. Downbeat had a whole, great big thing about it, how Diz was hanging onto his tails or something, slicing him. But scratched him on the hand, and there was trunks in the hallway where he was going, and he turned around fast. It kind of scared him, you know, and he hit his thigh on one of the locks on a trunk, you know.
That was worse than the scratch he had on the hand. But you know, they made a big thing out of it. Now, Mittler's there, the guy that manages the whole thing.
